title: Associated Bank Hires Kelly Mould to Lead Trust and Advisory Services
summary: Associated Bank today announced new hires and expanded leadership responsibilities to strengthen its private banking, trust and wealth management capabilities in Milwaukee, Madison and Chicago, including the appointment of Kelly Mould, J.D., as senior vice president, managing director of Trust and Advisory Services.
